explanation: Residual-budget contraction. On each sub-slab $[\alpha,\beta]$ the pair-gap budget is converted into two-coordinate costs $x^\beta+(s-x)_+^\beta>1$ that bound each off-diagonal entry against its partner, and each diagonal magnitude is bounded through its row norm by $F(N)=[N^p-(N-D/(2t))^p]^{1/p}$, $D$ the residual budget; monotone quantities are evaluated at the unfavourable endpoint. Each round only uses bounds proved in earlier rounds (`slab_generic`, sub-slab lemmas `sub_*`). The eight slabs with radii `slabRadius` are combined by a case split.
